title: Change values on column "Neighborhood" to match make_ames()
description:
Hi @topepo, this PR is my attempt to solve #9.

Below you can find the code I used to update `ames_new`.

```r
load("./data/ames_new.rda")

library(dplyr)

ames_new <- ames_new %>% mutate(
  Neighborhood = case_when(
    Neighborhood == "Hayden Lake" ~ "Hayden_Lake",
    Neighborhood == "NridgHt" ~ "Northridge",
    TRUE ~ Neighborhood
  )
)

save(ames_new, file = "./data/ames_new.rda")
```

title: Fix BsmtFin_SF_1 column in make_ames
description: Wrong column was used to create a preprocessed version of BsmtFin_SF_1 column: BsmtFin_Type_1 values was taken instead of BsmtFin_SF_1

title: Fix BsmtFin_SF_1 (don't overwrite with BsmtFin_Type1)
description:
This was probably a copy-paste bug. I noticed it when plotting all features against `Sale_Price`.

The right solution probably involves `dplyr::recode` / `recode_factor`, maybe with `dplyr::across`, so that this wouldn't have been able to happen. But I've spot-checked the adjacent values and they seem ok, so I'm leaving it at this for now.

title: add school districts in sf format
description:
This PR adds school district outlines and corrects school names in `ames_schools` for easy joining with the spatial counterpart. 
I renamed the dataset `ames_schools` to `ames_schools_geo` to avoid name collision and for consistency with other lat-long datasets.
The `sf` dependency is suggested. I hope the error will be self-explanatory if someone will try to load `ames_school_boundaries_sf` without having sf package loaded. So long it is properly described in documentation it should be enough.
